title: Rubbercore
description: A Mix of Hardcore and Normal Survival
body:
# Rubbercore

Rubbercore mixes Hardcore tension with normal survival gameplay.

Players are not banned on death. Instead, every death removes 1 max heart, making survival matter without locking anyone out of the server. Lost hearts can be recovered with craftable **Heart Crystals**, and players can even turn one of their own hearts into a tradable crystal with `/heart`.

This creates real risk, recovery, and player-driven trading without turning your SMP into full Hardcore.

## Features

- Players start with **10 hearts**
- Each death removes **1 max heart**
- Minimum health is **1 heart**
- **Heart Crystals** restore lost hearts
- `/heart` lets players remove one of their own hearts and receive a Heart Crystal item
- Heart Crystals can be kept, traded, or dropped for other players
